title: Policy Loan Rate Page for Whole Life Insurance Tiers
content:
Policy loan terms of Whole Life Insurance differ by Ashgrove tier. The loan interest rate below is the tier's loan interest rate, a fixed annual rate.

| Tier | First policy year a loan may be taken | Loan interest rate (annual) | Share of guaranteed cash value plus paid-up additions cash value that may be borrowed in total | Smallest new loan (USD) | Smallest repayment, unless it repays the loan in full (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life | 3 | 8% (0.08) | 90% (0.9) | 100 | 25 |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 | 2 | 6% (0.06) | 92% (0.92) | 250 | 50 |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 65 | 2 | 6% (0.06) | 92% (0.92) | 250 | 50 |
| Ashgrove 20-Pay Whole Life | 2 | 6% (0.06) | 92% (0.92) | 250 | 50 |
| Ashgrove 10-Pay Whole Life | 1 | 6% (0.06) | 92% (0.92) | 250 | 50 |
| Ashgrove Single Premium Whole Life | 1 | 5% (0.05) | 92% (0.92) | 250 | 50 |

**Loan default notice period (all tiers):** 31 calendar days after the loan default notice is mailed, before the policy terminates for excess indebtedness.

## Reading the page (hypothetical figures)

- A Final Expense policy in its 2nd policy year is below its first loan year (3); a Paid-Up at 65 policy in its 2nd policy year has reached its first loan year (2); a 10-Pay or Single Premium policy may borrow from policy year 1.
- On a Paid-Up at 100 policy with a guaranteed cash value of 40000.00 and a paid-up additions cash value of 10000.00, 92% of the 50000.00 total is 46000.00; on a Final Expense policy with the same values, 90% is 45000.00.
- A new loan of 250 dollars meets the smallest loan on the Paid-Up at 100 tier; 249.99 dollars does not. On the Final Expense tier 100 dollars is the smallest new loan.
- A repayment of 50 dollars meets the smallest repayment on the 20-Pay tier; a repayment of 30 dollars meets it only where it repays the whole loan.
